about.title: About
about.subtitle: Discover the story and values that drive Mey Beauty

history.title: Our story
history.p1: Mey Beauty was born from a passion for beauty and a deep respect for professional skincare expertise. Our founder, after years of experience in the beauty industry, was amazed by the power of advanced skincare technology and the beauty secrets passed down from professional to professional.
history.p2: The name Mey Beauty reflects our commitment to gentle, effective care - a reference to the gentleness of the treatments we offer and our respectful approach towards your skin.
history.p3: Today, Mey Beauty offers a range of professional skincare that combines the best of institute expertise with the demands of modern cosmetics, for effective, ethical, and skin-respecting products.

engagement.hero_desc: At Mey Beauty, we believe it's possible to take care of yourself while taking care of our planet. Our environmental and social commitment is at the heart of each of our decisions, from ingredient selection to the delivery of your orders.

ingredients.title: Natural ingredients
ingredients.desc: 100% of our ingredients are of natural origin, from organic farming or responsible wild harvesting.

packaging.desc: Our packaging is recyclable, biodegradable, or refillable. We minimize single-use plastic.

sourcing.title: Responsible sourcing
sourcing.desc: We select our ingredients from trusted suppliers practicing sustainable and environmentally responsible sourcing.

manufacturing.title: Ethical manufacturing
manufacturing.desc: Our products are manufactured in France in certified workshops, with environmentally friendly processes.

packaging.title: Minimal packaging
packaging.desc: We use only recycled or recyclable materials and eliminate any superfluous packaging.

delivery.title: Low-carbon delivery
delivery.desc: We prioritize carriers committed to reducing their carbon footprint and offset remaining emissions.

join.title: Join the movement
join.desc: By choosing Mey Beauty, you actively participate in a more responsible consumption model. Together, let's build a future where beauty rhymes with sustainability.

s1.title: 1. Purpose
s1.text: These general terms and conditions of sale govern the contractual relationships between Mey Beauty and any person making a purchase via our website. Any order implies unreserved acceptance of these conditions.

s2.title: 2. Products
s2.text: The products offered are those described on our site. Photographs are as faithful as possible but cannot guarantee perfect similarity with the product offered. Mey Beauty reserves the right to modify the product range at any time.

s3.title: 3. Prices
s3.text: Prices are indicated in euros, all taxes included. Mey Beauty reserves the right to modify its prices at any time, but products will be invoiced based on the rates in effect at the time of order validation.

s4.title: 4. Order
s4.text: The customer selects the products they wish to order and validates their order after reading these general conditions. Order validation constitutes acceptance of these conditions. An order confirmation is sent by email.

s5.title: 5. Payment
s5.text: Payment is made online by credit card via a secure payment platform. The order is validated after payment acceptance by banking institutions.

s6.title: 6. Delivery
s6.text: Products are delivered to the address indicated during the order. Delivery times are given for guidance only. Any delivery delay cannot give rise to damages or cancellation of the order.

s7.title: 7. Right of withdrawal
s7.text: In accordance with current legislation, the customer has a period of 14 days from receipt of their order to exercise their right of withdrawal, without having to justify reasons or pay penalties.

s8.title: 8. Liability
s8.text: Mey Beauty cannot be held responsible for damages resulting from misuse of products. It is the customer's responsibility to verify the product's suitability for their intended use and to respect usage precautions.

s9.title: 9. Disputes
s9.text: These conditions are governed by French law. In case of dispute, an amicable solution will be sought before any legal action. Failing that, French courts will have sole jurisdiction.

s10.title: 10. Contact
s10.text: For any questions regarding these conditions, you can contact us at: contact@meybeauty.fr

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At Mey Beauty, we place great importance on protecting your personal data. This policy explains how we collect and use your information.

s1.title: 1. Data collection
s1.text: We collect the information you provide when creating your account, placing orders, or exchanging with our customer service (name, email, address, etc.).

s2.title: 2. Data use
s2.text: Your data is used for order management, service improvement, and, if you have consented, sending information about our products and offers.

s3.title: 3. Data sharing
s3.text: Mey Beauty does not sell your data to third parties. We share it only with our technical providers necessary for order execution (carriers, payment platforms).

s4.title: 4. Your rights
s4.text: In accordance with GDPR, you have the right to access, rectify, delete, and object to the processing of your personal data.

s1.title: Shipping methods
s1.text: We deliver to Mainland France and Europe via Colissimo and Chronopost. Shipping is free in France for orders over €50.

s2.title: Delivery times
s2.text: Orders are processed within 24 to 48 business hours. Usual delivery time is 2 to 4 business days in France.

s3.title: Returns & exchanges
s3.text: You have 14 days to return an unopened product. Return costs are at your expense, except in case of defective product or our error.
